text: {"label":"Methods for Training Parents and Caregivers","definition":"Research on how to teach parents and other caregivers to implement behavioral assessment and intervention, including behavioral skills training, coaching, pyramidal and remote delivery, and barriers to effective training.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on the methods and effectiveness of training caregivers, rather than family perceptions and support, early-intervention therapist practices, or pediatric healthcare applications of behavior analysis."}
